reason: I'd never move a property-sale lump sum on the strength of an ad. I'd post it in the WhatsApp group first, and my relative in India says he can sort the paperwork for free.
objection: I don't know anyone who has used you. Nobody in my community group or association has vouched for you, and it's a big sum to hand to a company I just saw once.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three people in my WhatsApp group or temple association saying they moved a similar amount with you and it arrived on time.
